{"id":1903751783,"question_id":4194,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1769913534,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"1300 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1903751783/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Monobit Integers","memory":"88.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string binary(int n)\n    {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        while(n > 0){\n            char d = n % 2;\n            ans.push_back(d + '0');\n            n /= 2;\n        }    \n        reverse(ans.begin() , ans.end());\n        return ans;\n    }\n\n    bool samesame(string num)\n    {\n        set<char>st;\n        for(auto it : num) st.insert(it);\n        return st.size() == 1;        \n    }\n    \n    int countMonobit(int n) {\n        int count = 2;\n        if(n == 0) return 1;\n        for(int i = 2 ; i<=n ; i++){\n            string number = binary(i);\n            cout<<number<<endl;\n            if(samesame(number)) count++;\n        }\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-monobit-integers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1622}
